limitations: Desktop evidence uses a declared native 1280 x 1900 viewport so the real Pause and command controls can remain in one large window; DEV01/02 used a shorter viewport and missed the natural three-second status.
Mobile evidence checks arena layout and horizontal overflow only; no complete mobile command journey is claimed.
The displayed geometry is a bounded two-dimensional ATB arena, not an original map, obstacle collision solver, sprite motion or 3D animation. Other powers retain their documented abstract ranges.
Damage multiplier and exact resource/RNG atomicity are native-test findings; screenshots only establish visible feedback and positions.
No new original models, ranks, class progression, full campaign or artistic fidelity is certified.
result: All original captures have an explicit SHA-matched actual-opening attestation in the linked original review.
